name: telegram-howto
description: Operating manual for Telegram over its MCP connector and roughly 115 tools: how to find a chat by title, the tool inventory grouped by job, resolving chat ids, auto-transcribing voice notes, and the connector gotchas (pinned-first ordering, big-page crashes, reload after reconnect, untrusted fields, always passing an explicit account). Load before any non-trivial Telegram work.
